decisive_items: extrahepatic metastasis of HCC was suspected
history of HBV-positive hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) treated with partial hepatectomy
response.rationale: Patient has known HCC, elevated AFP, liver nodules, and a flank mass invading rib; imaging and history strongly favor HCC extrahepatic metastasis over primary sarcoma or isolated lung metastasis.

rejected.why: Soft tissue sarcoma is only a differential to exclude; history and AFP favor HCC metastasis.
Pulmonary nodules are part of metastatic HCC, not the primary diagnosis.
